source.title: Live births by sex and urban/rural residence
source.note: UN Demographic Yearbook compiles official national civil-registration statistics. Code C denotes data assessed as virtually complete (at least 90%). For Lithuania, the 1999 value uses the later revised 2000 Yearbook record; the 1999 natality special table showed a provisional total without sex breakdown.

coverage.note: The UN 1980–1999 natality table reports Lithuania's total births for 1980–1984 but does not publish a male/female split for those years, therefore the comparable sex-ratio series starts in 1985.
